Faq.title: Frequently
Faq.subtitle: Direct answers on how we operate in our projects. For custom scenarios, please get in touch.
Faq.noAnswerDesc: Get in touch directly with our engineers. We get back to you within 2 business hours.

items.q: How does the contracting model for services work?
items.a: We work with two modalities: fixed scope (ideal for well-specified projects) and partnerships in the form of on-demand squads or continuous monthly maintenance.

items.q: What technology is used in the projects?
items.a: We select the ideal stack based on business and infrastructure requirements. We have deep expertise in Java, Kotlin, TypeScript/JavaScript (Next.js/React/Node.js), Python, and Go.

items.q: How do you handle data security and confidentiality?
items.a: We adopt OWASP best practices, encryption at rest and in transit, and sign non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) before any technical deep dive.

items.q: Is it possible to modernize legacy systems without impacting the operation?
items.a: Yes. We use proven architectural patterns such as Strangler Fig for gradual migration and automated regression testing, aiming to minimize production impact.

items.q: How can I track the progress of development?
items.a: We maintain a high level of project visibility through alignment meetings, progress dashboards integrated into Jira/GitLab, and direct access to staging repositories.
Yes. When agreed in the proposal, we offer support and monitoring contracts with written service targets (SLA) — not as a generic promise on this website.

Services_desenvolvimento.metaDesc: Customized software engineering. Resilient enterprise systems built in TypeScript, Java, and Kotlin with a focus on quality.
Services_desenvolvimento.title: Custom software
Services_desenvolvimento.subtitle: Robust corporate solutions tailored to the operational specificities of your business.
Services_desenvolvimento.intro: Off-the-shelf software models often fail to handle custom business rules and data scalability. We create highly flexible applications structured on modern and secure code, ready to grow linearly.
benefits: Strong reduction of manual-processing errors
Average reduction of up to 70% in operational rework
Full ownership of the source code, eliminating vendor lock-in
Scalable architecture built to handle 10x more traffic
System design documentation and continuous knowledge transfer

faq.q: How is the development timeline determined?
faq.a: We use iterative methodologies based on delivery milestones. Functional MVPs are deployed in 4 to 8 weeks, while complex systems typically have schedules of 3 to 6 months.
We prefer mature stacks with community and enterprise support, including Java, Kotlin, TypeScript, Python, and Go. The final choice depends on the project context.
The client has access to biweekly demos, real-time dashboards, and a direct channel with the responsible technical team.

Services_web-mobile.metaTitle: High-Performance Web & Mobile Apps | H2V Systems
Services_web-mobile.metaDesc: Modern web applications and optimized mobile apps (Next.js, Flutter, React Native) with instant load times and high performance.
Services_web-mobile.title: Enterprise applications
Services_web-mobile.subtitle: Fast, responsive, and intuitive interfaces focused on high-performance digital engagement.
Services_web-mobile.intro: Modern systems require fluid interfaces. We develop digital experiences optimized at the network and rendering level, with excellent performance across mobile and desktop devices.
benefits: Designed targeting high Lighthouse scores (goal: 90+ on new projects)
Extreme optimization for search engine indexing (SEO)
Cross-platform development with business logic reuse
Offline support via PWA technologies when the project scope allows
Accessibility best practices guided by WCAG (conformance level assessed per project)

faq.q: What is the best approach: PWA, hybrid, or native?
faq.a: We analyze hardware requirements. PWAs or frameworks like React Native and Flutter meet the vast majority of business scenarios with lower maintenance costs.

faq.q: Does H2V Systems manage app store publishing?
faq.a: Yes, we handle the entire deployment process, policy compliance, and publishing on Google Play and Apple App Store.

faq.q: Is it possible to redesign an active production product?
faq.a: Yes, we work on incremental modernization of interfaces without interrupting service to active users.

Services_arquitetura.metaTitle: Software Architecture & Cloud Computing | H2V Systems
Services_arquitetura.metaDesc: Complex systems design, resilient APIs, cloud migration to AWS, and fault-tolerant infrastructure based on Kubernetes.
Services_arquitetura.title: Systems architecture
Services_arquitetura.subtitle: Resilient, scalable technological structures with highly optimized costs.
Services_arquitetura.intro: Inconsistent architecture and wasted cloud resources compromise operational profitability. We design fault-tolerant ecosystems under modern microservices and secure serverless approaches.
benefits: Data architecture resilient to severe traffic spikes
Average reduction of up to 50% in cloud billing costs
High operational availability with automated failover
Automated CI/CD pipelines for agile deployments in minutes
Complete environment telemetry (Structured logs, Metrics, and APM)

faq.q: When should we migrate from a monolith to microservices?
faq.a: Migration is recommended when different teams need to work independently or when specific parts of the system require very different scale boundaries.
We work with the leading market players, with an emphasis on AWS, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Microsoft Azure solutions.

faq.q: How does the infrastructure migration process occur?
faq.a: We follow controlled transition strategies with parallel validations, aiming to minimize downtime windows (near-zero downtime approach).

Services_dados.metaDesc: Optimization of slow PostgreSQL queries, structured NoSQL modeling, automated ETL data pipelines, and GDPR compliance.
Services_dados.title: Data engineering
Services_dados.subtitle: Efficient modeling, performance optimization, and analytical data intelligence.
Services_dados.intro: Poorly optimized databases cause general sluggishness in enterprise systems. We restructure your data schemas, implement smart indexes, and build reliable processing pipelines.
benefits: Extreme query acceleration in relational databases
Structuring of fast analytical pipelines (ETL/ELT)
Real-time integrated BI dashboards
Design of secure backup, replication, and Disaster Recovery policies
Full technical compliance with GDPR data governance requirements

faq.q: How to decide between relational and non-relational databases?
faq.a: We analyze the nature of the data. SQL models provide strong ACID guarantees for complex transactions, while NoSQL is recommended for large unstructured volumes.

faq.q: Do you perform complex migrations of active data schemas?
faq.a: Yes, we structure logical replication plans to move terabytes of data without lockups or application operation downtime.

faq.q: How does the database optimization service work?
faq.a: We audit server configurations, indexing, and slow queries, delivering immediate performance improvements in the first weeks.

Services_integracoes.metaTitle: System Integrations & Enterprise Automation | H2V Systems
Services_integracoes.metaDesc: Secure integration between ERP, CRM, Payment Gateways, and legacy systems. Robust and efficient data pipelines built with APIs.
Services_integracoes.title: Complex integrations
Services_integracoes.subtitle: Native data flow connection, eliminating rework and operational bottlenecks.
Services_integracoes.intro: Manual spreadsheets and repetitive copying of data between different software cause business delays and failures. We precisely integrate your ERPs, CRMs, and payment gateways via optimized APIs.
benefits: Hundreds of hours of operational work automated per month
Immediate data synchronization across multiple platforms
Drastic reduction in registry and inventory inconsistencies
Integrated automation of billing, invoicing, and reports
Transparent audit logs of all communications

faq.q: Is it possible to integrate with legacy software without an API?
faq.a: Yes, we develop integrators that interact directly with the database or implement secure synchronization bots.

faq.q: How do you handle integrity during third-party network failures?
faq.a: We implement messaging-based architectures with retry queues configured to favor consistent and idempotent asynchronous processing.

faq.q: How long does an integration project usually take?
faq.a: It depends on the systems integrated. Common scenarios from ERP to Web platforms are usually implemented in a few weeks.

Services_consultoria.metaTitle: Systems Consulting & Tech Audit | H2V Systems
Services_consultoria.metaDesc: Source code auditing, security tech audit, architecture evaluation, cloud optimization consulting, and technical mentoring.
Services_consultoria.title: Technical consulting
Services_consultoria.subtitle: In-depth technical analysis, architectural risk assessments, and technology evolution roadmaps.
Services_consultoria.intro: Incorrect technology decisions are costly in the long run. We conduct complete security, code quality, and performance audits to back future investments with confidence.
benefits: Complete diagnosis of vulnerabilities and bottlenecks in up to 3 weeks
Strategic roadmap containing estimated costs, impacts, and efforts
Technical source code review aligned with industry security guidelines
Detailed modernization plans focused on return on investment
Technical training and mentoring for internal development teams

faq.q: How is the technical audit executed?
faq.a: We analyze code repositories, infrastructure configurations, and conduct interviews with the internal technical engineering team.

faq.q: Can H2V Systems guide the hiring and structuring of the internal team?
faq.a: Yes, we support technical evaluation processes and profile definitions tailored to the company's objectives.
The client receives an in-depth diagnostic report, reference architectures, and the technical transition plan presentation.
